SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)

WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-03-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT g.region_group, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS g ON g.region_id = s.region_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY g.region_group

WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT s.store_name FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS cancelled_pct FROM analytics.fact_orders WHERE CAST((ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)

WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id), store_net AS (SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.store_id) SELECT s.store_name FROM analytics.fact_sales_targets AS t JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = t.store_id LEFT JOIN store_net AS sn ON sn.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.month_start = CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND COALESCE(sn.net, 0) < t.target_net_revenue_idr

WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: default = net revenue for calendar year 2025 (state calendar vs fiscal year)

cases.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: default = the product with the most units sold (non-cancelled) over all available data

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT c.is_online, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = n.channel_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY c.is_online
assumptions: default = net revenue in 2026 to date (Jan-Sep), online channels vs physical stores

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.store_id), refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT g.region_group FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = n.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS g ON g.region_id = s.region_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY g.region_group ORDER BY SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
assumptions: default = average order value (AOV) over all available data; alternative = spend per customer
